main_text.p: LIV. Drogo, ex Abbate Ostiensi Episcopus, undecimo jam sæculo, conspicuæ virtutis & eruditionis: Libro de creatione & redempt. primi hominis, citat locum Hebr. xi, 36. de quibus Apostolus loquitur sic &c.

LV. Sed ad ea jam deventum tem-pora, quæ sibi vendicat sequior Scholasti-corum ætas. Quanquam ex Anselmo, Bernardo, Hugone S. Victoris &c. quæ-dam Latinorum Patrum velut appendi-ce, geminæ pro Paulo Epistolæ scriptore authoritates, proferri possent in medium. Prout hic διαρρήδην[?] in Catalogo Librorum N.T. Cap. VIII[?]. Speculi Ecclesiæ, Epistolis Paulinis annumerat illam ad Hebræos. Sed de recentiorum mente haud ita la-boramus. Adeóque hæc de Veterum, quos usurpare quidem licuit, testimoniis hactenus: Nec de fuissent plura, si forulos omnes excutere, & numero certare animus fuisset. Verum enim vero hoc imprimis superesset, ut de illis constaret, qui Epistolæ sive authorem, sive authoritatem ex Latinis fecere dubiam. Utque motarii[?] su- pra

page.notes: The running head reads "De Authore Epistolæ"; the final letter is uncertain. The Greek word after "hic" is partly smudged; reading as διαρρήδην is uncertain. "Cap. VIII" is uncertain in its final numeral. "motarii" is uncertain. The last word on the page, "supra", is continued from the line above (the catchword is "prā"). The black blob at the lower left is a scan artefact and is not transcribed.
